body:
Parent #1202. Deliver the complete source comparisons for packages [2, 3], with one focused PR per package (maximum two). This issue owns only `coordination/engineering/global-source-comparisons-b-20261006/`; the sibling issue owns the other packages. No shared code, gate or geography mutations.

The four disjoint packages together contain 9,587 complete families and 57,785 components, including all 1,391 unique compatible-source witnesses and 123 numerical consistency unknowns. The remaining complement contains 6,023 families and 37,388 components. Existing comparisons each have one actual scientific execution pinned by private code SHA; two final committed-producer executions remain required.

- Package 2: complete scope SHA-256 `af192697fb6af9e7d6af503129f86e9badf391d0c75e2c17f97192a0645ca751`; immutable local handoff `.cache/repair-readiness-1231-20261006/direct-source-coverage-screen/complete-family-package-measure/package-002-author-scope.json`.
- Package 3: complete scope SHA-256 `2f941b49282e3ea2ac88cd4e30653a14694a5bd253e629b6ab7d484e500047ed`; immutable local handoff `.cache/repair-readiness-1231-20261006/direct-source-coverage-screen/complete-family-package-measure/package-003-author-scope.json`.

Measured full budget including each exact scope: packages 0/1/2/3 = 263,410,146 / 263,429,296 / 263,478,375 / 263,575,762 encoded bytes. Proof SHA-256 `198316e71838f028fc1a4853e9f3606e9f22d67b637059f88f289507bedc177a`. All ordinary encoded/decoded files fit 32 MiB and aggregate fits 256 MiB; at least 4,859,694 bytes remain for final code/controls/receipts. This is measured packaging proof, not final admission or scientific reproduction. Recheck the complete actual final manifest.

Acceptance:
- Finalize measured dependency-closed complete-family package scopes before authoring. Respect every existing encoded/decoded/aggregate/descriptor bound. Keep the whole 57,785-component roster and exact 37,388-component complement; no clipping, cutoff, sampling or omission to fit a budget.
- Preserve exact original source bodies through the independently accepted source-corpus aliases, verifying original whole decoded hashes and full-feature order. Preserve their relationship to previously consumed containing files/archives. Keep original and current vintages distinct; never label a pending PR or scientific preview as selected production.
- Freeze the actual loader, unchanged geometry kernel, numerical consistency diagnoses, complete scopes and existing-codec packaging producer in Git before final scientific executions. Reuse existing ordinary gzip/object support. Do not create a general codec/gate framework or widen limits.
- Execute every complete final scope twice using that immutable producer and pinned actual runtime. Retain exact execution commands, timestamps, outcomes, whole input hashes and outputs. Keep the eight historical one-run/private-SHA receipts as historical evidence; do not relabel packing or hash checks as scientific reproduction.
- Independently demonstrate canonical complete-row and full-geometry equality against the retained original results, preserving original containing-file hashes and row ordinals. Source aliases may change custody layout; science pointsets and decisions may not change silently. Any numerical or input disagreement remains an explicit failure/unknown until investigated.
- Retain meaningful positive and negative controls for full pointset custody, source/Atlas intersection and difference, holes, zero contacts, missing/invalid source bodies, duplicate/omitted members, water/source ambiguity and numerical consistency. No snapped/buffered/MakeValid/nearest-location repair operation.
- Publish the complete remaining source/member plan for 6,023 families /37,388 components, including 5,139 candidates without source bindings, 35 graph-only intermediates and13 unresolved leaves. Original-member availability is not authority or causation approval.
- Complete current-contract-bound independent source/geometry/implementation review, ordinary admission, required CI, normal serialized integration and actual whole-byte/mode readback for every package. Reconcile all original acceptance and preserve unique evidence before releasing only the author's claim/checkout.

Partial packages use Refs and retain all remaining obligations on the original issue. Closing this bounded delivery issue does not complete #1202, approve any geography/water/ownership, or authorize deployment. Global classification, supported repairs and delivery remain separate requirements.


Use the standard branch-ID-owned manifest path in the canonical contract below, keeping the previously delivered package intact on later branches. First package uses the global-source-comparisons-b-20261006 branch ID and its matching top namespace; the second package uses global-source-comparisons-b-package3-20261006 and its separate matching namespace. Frozen first-package producer/input paths remain unchanged inside the first namespace. Only this issue’s two package scopes must be authored; preserve the full global complement/remaining-member plan as context. Exact original inputs are already authenticated and available; source custody PR #1240 and native PR #1231 remain distinct integration jobs, not artificial readiness dependencies. Declare actual input vintages and immutable aliases honestly.
